items.name: sfx_boing
items.text: A single cartoon spring boing, a springy comic wobble that bounces and fades quickly. No music, no voice.

items.name: sfx_snip
items.text: A single crisp snip of small scissors cutting one silk thread. Close and clean, no music, no voice.

items.name: sfx_snap
items.text: A single sharp snap of a taut silk cord breaking, a quick thin crack with a tiny whip of the loose ends. No music, no voice.

items.name: sfx_pop
items.text: A single soft cartoon pop, like a cork or a bubble popping, short and bright. No music, no voice.

items.name: sfx_sparkle
items.text: A short magical sparkle shimmer, tiny glassy chimes twinkling upward and fading. No music, no voice.

items.name: sfx_bookshut
items.text: A single heavy old hardcover ledger slammed shut, a deep papery thump with a puff of pages. No music, no voice.

items.name: sfx_paper
items.text: A crisp paper pop-up card springing open, a quick flutter of folded paper unfolding. No music, no voice.

items.name: sfx_wood
items.text: A single small wooden plaque knocking once against a wooden beam, a soft hollow clack. No music, no voice.

items.name: sfx_swish
items.text: A soft quick swish of a book flying past, airy and smooth, rising then falling. No music, no voice.

items.name: sfx_thump
items.text: A soft muffled thump of a woolly mitten pressed against a microphone, close, with a faint fabric rub. No music, no voice.
